A supported platform

Step 1 of 6
NextHolding a platform

A platform is bonded to a fixed wall.

The wall and platform are separate bodies. Their bond is a separate relationship with its own identity and state.

  • World data supplies the wall’s fixed behaviour.
  • The bond restricts the attached platform’s motion.
Records and applicable rules

W wall · P platform · C bond

ConcernOutcome
BodiesW and P
RelationshipC joins W to P

Stored or selected

  • W: wall geometry, fixed behaviour and stable identity from world data.
  • P: its current shape, motion, and selected material, response and appearance inputs.
  • C: endpoint IDs and local attachment regions that recover its intended rigid fit; authored strength and applicable failure settings.

Derived

  • Unity bodies, colliders, the connector joint, visuals, and reverse lookups.

An authored composite expands into pieces and connectors; it does not add a canonical assembly entity. Diagram geometry and origins are illustrative.
